thread:
adele: Heads up, CI on main is failing - SAST job keeps erroring during artifact decryption after last night's key rotation
adele: snippet: `ERROR: KMS: PermissionDenied: Caller lacks permission kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt for projects/redwood-prod/.../scan-key`
samir: that's odd, rotation pipeline was supposed to update the iam binding via iam-sync. Did it run successfully?
marcus: deploy logs show alias swapped and an intermediate key version present. scanner tries to decrypt with alias -> KMS responds NotFound -> then PermissionDenied
maria: i'm looking at KMS policy now. The new key resource id is `scan-key-v2026-03-12` and the terraform rotation destroyed/created keys (not in-place), so the IAM binding that referenced the old cryptoKey resource didn't reattach
scanner-ci-bot: SCANNER_JOB_FAILED: job_id=ci-sast-main-8942 reason=decrypt_failure
ops-oncall: I can temp-grant the scanner service account if someone posts the exact resource name. Ephemeral grants need request + audit note
samir: resource: `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/scanner/cryptoKeys/scan-key-v2026-03-12`
maria: applying grant: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding scan-key-v2026-03-12 --location=global --keyring=scanner --member=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`
ops-oncall: created ephemeral grant (ttl=45m), recorded audit entry: `iam: bind scanner-sa -> scan-key-v2026-03-12 by maria (ephemeral)`
marcus: requeue the CI please, also FYI the aborted SAST run produced partial evidence tarball - we should avoid re-triaging those results as new findings
adele: re-run command: `./ci/trigger_scan.sh --scope=main --scanner=remote`
scanner-ci-bot: SCANNER_JOB_REQUEUED: job_id=ci-sast-main-8942
samir: if this clears, we'll need follow-ups: 1) rotation pipeline must validate IAM bindings for the new key before making it active, 2) terraform keystore should preserve a stable alias resource instead of recreating raw cryptoKey ids
maria: agreed. i'll open a TF PR to create an alias cryptoKey resource and attach bindings to it, plus a lifecycle rule to prevent accidental destroy during rotation
security-bot: INCIDENT_LOGGED: sast-decrypt-rotation (sev=medium) owner=eng-security
ops-oncall: scan job progressing... looks like decrypt step succeeded now
scanner-ci-bot: SCANNER_JOB_SUCCEEDED: job_id=ci-sast-main-8942 artifacts=ok
marcus: great. next: evidence-agregator needs to mark partial runs as `incomplete` and not emit findings until an archive completes successfully
adele: also let's add a small pre-commit check in rotation pipeline that calls `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` for the new cryptoKey and fails the promotion if scanner-sa isn't bound
samir: I'll prototype a bash check + unit test for rotation pipeline; propose a canary rotation in staging first so we exercise iam-sync there
maria: leaving a detailed note in the key-rotation playbook: exact gcloud commands, how to rollback a key rotation, and how to request an ephemeral grant via ops-oncall
security-bot: SUGGESTION: schedule staging dry-run in 5d and add alert rule `k_rotate_alias_mismatch` to detect alias-resource != binding on scanner-sa
adele: creating a short postmortem with action items: terraform alias, iam-sync change, rotation precheck, evidence dedupe, alert rule. will assign owners and due dates
ops-oncall: all clear from my side, ephemeral grant expired, CI remains green :thumbsup:
